label: NHC Tropical Weather → TAK
info:
Active tropical storms and hurricanes from the National Hurricane Center: current positions, forecast tracks and cones.

Data: NOAA NHC map services (https://mapservices.weather.noaa.gov/tropical/). Updates every 15 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/nhc-tropical
